title: Klammerdiagramm — janmarogamaraṇādiḥ (Leitan comparison)
desc: Leitan's X-ādi bahuvrīhi example janma-roga-maraṇa-ādiḥ (his vigraha: janma ca rogaś ca maraṇaṃ ca ādayaḥ yasya sa bhāvaḥ): flat dvandva block A = janma·roga·maraṇa, mirrored head B = [A]+ādiḥ. II часть at ādiḥ (asked). Drawn for the H982 comparison.
